profile.visual_desc: Blue-skinned demonic sorcerer in a thick navy-blue hooded robe with grey trim. Rear-facing view showing a heavy, draped silhouette.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Pale blue skin, sharp chin, and cold features. Features a glowing blue reptilian slit eye and ribbed demonic ear structures.
profile.weapon_desc: A short wooden catalyst wand held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing up-left. Figure stands steady in heavy robes, wand held up and ready.
profile.step2_windup: Slight forward lean toward the target direction. The figure stabilizes the wand, focusing energy for release.
profile.step3_impact: Thrusts wand forward. A jagged, multi-pointed white and light-blue energy starburst erupts from the tip toward the top-left.
profile.step4_finish: The bright energy burst shatters into fading sparks as the figure returns to a neutral standing posture.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The radial energy burst in Frame 4 originates precisely at the wand's tip, following the line of the forward thrust.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation adheres to source poses; VFX is correctly aligned and timed.
